Hallowmere — The Ashen Vigil: audio palette v2

Sound design and synthesis: original Hallowmere workshop.
Recorded source material: Kenney, Impact Sounds (2019) and RPG Audio (2014).
License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0).
https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Sources were edited, layered, filtered, pitch shifted, and granulated.
Detailed provenance and publisher license text: scripts/audio-sources/.
Rebuild with npm run generate:audio.
